Accolades

  • Todd McFarlane earned a nomination for Eisner Award in 1988 in "Best Artist" category for this volume.[1]
  • Peter David and Dale Keown won Eisner Award in 1992 in "Best Writer/Artist" category for this volume. The volume also earned a nomination in "Best Continuing Series" category. Mark Farmer earned a nomination in "Best Inker" category for this volume.[2]
  1. ↑ 1988 Will Eisner Comic Industry Award Nominees HahnLibrary.net. Retrieved on January 10, 2025.
  2. ↑ 1992 Will Eisner Comic Industry Award Nominees HahnLibrary.net. Retrieved on January 26, 2025.
